A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Sanyassan''' with an [[Eye patch/Legends|eye patch]] over his right [[Eye/Legends|eye]] was a member of the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. The [[Sanyassan/Legends|Sanyassan]] was on guard duty on a curtain wall of [[Terak's Keep]] when [[Noa Briqualon]], [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Wystri Warrick]], and [[Teek (Teek)|Teek]] stormed the [[Castle/Legends|castle]] to rescue the captive [[Human/Legends|Human]] girl [[Cindel Towani]]. When the Sanyassan noticed Briqualon climbing a [[Rope/Legends|rope]] and scaling the side of the castle, he prepared to fire his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]&mdash;little did he know that Warrick had tied the other end of the rope around his ankle. A shove from Warrick sent the Sanyassan tumbling over the side of the curtain wall and into the moat below while simultaneously propelling Briqualon to the top.
